title: Inclusion of Animal Welfare Content in Character and Citizenship Education Syllabus
what_it_is: Inclusion of Animal Welfare Content in Character and Citizenship Education Syllabus

sections.label: Animal welfare in school curriculum
sections.summary: Students at primary, secondary and pre-university levels learn about animal welfare, responsibility and animal cruelty offences through refreshed curriculum contexts and Values-In-Action projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The contexts used to discuss such issues are regularly refreshed to include contemporary examples.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: At the primary level, students learn about responsibility and care towards animals, including responsible pet ownership.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students at secondary and pre-university levels learn about making a positive difference to social and environmental issues including animal welfare.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Some students have embarked on Values-In-Action Projects that contribute towards animal welfare and even started interest groups to promote animal welfare.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Our teachers do incorporate useful information, including the impact of committing offences related to animal cruelty.

sections.label: Reviewing animal welfare curriculum content
sections.summary: The member hopes to expand animal welfare awareness and upstream solutions, and says the curriculum will be reviewed in due course to meet students' learning needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I think we have had it for many years and I am hoping that we can expand it further, so that we can create greater awareness on animal welfare issues and go upstream, in terms of solving some of the animal abuse that we are currently seeing in our community.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We always review our curriculum and the curriculum is being published on MOE's website.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On reviewing animal welfare content in our subjects, we will certainly do so, in due course, to meet our students' learning needs.
